summary: Iteration 27 - Order Detail Page, Deployment History, and Generators in Radius testing completed. All 14 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working including map display, radius configuration, generator discovery, and navigation.

order_detail_endpoint.description: Returns full order detail with geocoded coordinates (center_lat, center_lng), radius_km, address_raw

order_settings_update.description: Updates order radius_km, persists to MongoDB

generators_in_radius.description: Returns generators within configured radius, sorted by distance

deployment_create.description: Creates deployment history entry with generator_id, operating_hours, kwh, etc.

deployment_get_by_order.description: Returns all deployments for an order

deployment_get_by_generator.description: Returns all deployments for a specific generator

auth_required.description: All new endpoints require JWT Bearer authentication

frontend_order_row_click.description: Clicking order row in /orders navigates to /orders/:pk detail page

frontend_order_info_cards.description: Shows Event/Projekt, Kunde, Lieferanschrift cards with data

frontend_map_display.description: Leaflet map displays centered on delivery address with radius circle

frontend_radius_input.description: Radius can be changed and saved, shows toast on success

frontend_generators_panel.description: Shows generators within radius with name, model, serial, distance

frontend_deployment_history.description: Einsatzhistorie section displayed on generator detail page

frontend_no_coordinates.description: Orders without geocoded address show 'Keine Koordinaten verfügbar' message

frontend_tests.orders_page: PASS - Table with clickable rows, status filter defaulting to Bestätigt
frontend_tests.order_detail_page: PASS - Info cards, map, radius input, generators panel all working
frontend_tests.map_functionality: PASS - Leaflet map with radius circle, center marker, generator markers
frontend_tests.radius_save: PASS - Radius updates saved and reflected in generator list
frontend_tests.generator_navigation: PASS - Click generator in panel navigates to detail page
frontend_tests.back_navigation: PASS - Back button returns to orders list
frontend_tests.deployment_history: PASS - Einsatzhistorie section visible on generator detail
